rounds.ai_message: Hello, this is Sarah from StyleHouse UK. We sent you an RFQ last week for men's polo shirts. Did you receive it?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 你好,我是英国 StyleHouse 的 Sarah。我们上周给你发了男款 polo 衫的询盘。你收到了吗?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认收到 RFQ,简述已读内容
rounds.common_mistakes: RFQ = Request For Quotation(询盘),读作 'ar-f-q' 或 'request for quote',不要念字母。
rounds.tips_zh: RFQ 是外贸第一环节。收到后第一步是回 thank you for your inquiry,表示已读。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, thank you for your inquiry. I received the RFQ on Monday and have been working on the quotation. To make sure I quote correctly, could you walk me through the key details?

rounds.ai_message: Sure. We need 2,000 pieces per color, 3 colors. 100% cotton pique, 220 GSM. Logo embroidery on the left chest. Pack 1 pc per polybag, 30 pcs per carton.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。每个颜色 2000 件,3 个颜色。100% 棉珠地,220 克。左边胸口 logo 刺绣。包装 1 件 1 胶袋,30 件 1 箱。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 复述关键参数,确认理解一致
rounds.common_mistakes: pique 是珠地网眼布,不要拼成 pick / peak。
rounds.tips_zh: 复述 RFQ 是专业做法:面料/克重/印花/包装 都要重复一遍,避免后续返工。
rounds.user_response_example: Got it. Just to confirm: 2,000 pieces per color, 3 colors, total 6,000 pieces. 100% cotton pique, 220 GSM. Logo embroidery on left chest. Packing: 1 pc per polybag, 30 pcs per master carton. Is that correct?

rounds.ai_message: Yes, that's right. We need delivery by sea to Felixstowe, target price US$5.50 FOB Shanghai. When can we have your offer?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 对,没错。海运到费利克斯托,目标价 FOB 上海 5.5 美元。什么时候能报价?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 承诺报价时间(常见 24-48 小时),不要当场口头报价
rounds.common_mistakes: offer 在外贸里是'报价单',不是'offers'复数。
rounds.tips_zh: 不要在电话里随便口头报价,要承诺 24/48 小时内出正式报价单。
rounds.user_response_example: Understood. FOB Shanghai, US$5.50 is your target. Let me check yarn and embroidery costs — I'll send you a formal offer by email within 24 hours. Could you also send the logo file in vector format for the embroidery?

rounds.ai_message: I'll send the logo tonight. The PI should be in US dollars, payment by TT 30/70. Anything else you need from us?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 今晚我发 logo 给你。PI 用美元,付款 TT 30/70。还有什么需要的?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明 PI 要包含的内容,以及确认有效期
rounds.common_mistakes: PI = Proforma Invoice(形式发票),不是 Purchase Invoice(那是采购发票)。
rounds.tips_zh: PI 必备字段:价格条款、数量、交期、付款方式、有效期、开证行信息(如有)。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes — the PI will include unit price, total amount, FOB Shanghai, lead time, TT 30% deposit and 70% balance before shipment, and it will be valid for 30 days. Please confirm your shipping mark and any special carton markings you'd like.

rounds.ai_message: Carton mark is just 'STYLEHOUSE UK' in black on two sides. Send the PI to sarah@stylehouse.co.uk. By the way, is your price firm or can you do better?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 箱唛就写 'STYLEHOUSE UK' 黑色印两侧。PI 发 sarah@stylehouse.co.uk。顺便问下,你价格是实在的,还是有商量余地?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 礼貌告知有讨论空间,但要看量
rounds.common_mistakes: is your price firm 是问'你价格实不实在',不是说'你公司稳不稳'。
rounds.tips_zh: 议价:可以留余地,但要在客户问的时候才说,不要主动给折扣。
rounds.user_response_example: The price I send is our best offer for 2,000 pieces per color. If you can increase to 3,000 per color, I can take another look at the price for you. But at the current quantity, US$5.50 is the best I can do.

rounds.ai_message: 3,000 per color is too much for us. Let's stick with 2,000. Just try to keep it competitive. So FOB Shanghai US$5.50 — yes or no?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 3 千一件太多了,还是 2 千。尽量有竞争力。FOB 上海 5.5 美元,行不行?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 如果达不到,解释差距,提出折中价 + 配套条件
rounds.common_mistakes: yes or no 是 closed question,不要在没办法的时候硬回 yes。
rounds.tips_zh: 答不到客户目标时,不要直接说 no,要说 'I can do X if you can Y'。
rounds.user_response_example: Honestly, US$5.50 FOB Shanghai is below our cost line at 2,000 pieces. I can do US$5.85 if you confirm within 5 business days, or US$5.75 if you pay 40% deposit. What works for you?

rounds.ai_message: OK, US$5.85 it is. Let me check with my boss and come back to you tomorrow. Anything else I should know?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好,5.85 美元。我和老板说一下,明天回你。还有什么我需要知道的吗?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明下单流程 + 备货时间,引导下一步
rounds.common_mistakes: deposit received date = 收到定金日,这是交期起算点,要在 PI 上写明。
rounds.tips_zh: 交期起算点:deposit received date / PO confirmed date / lab dip approved date,要在 PI 上明确。
rounds.user_response_example: Two important things: first, lead time of 35 days starts from the deposit received date, not the PO date. Second, please send the logo in AI or CDR format — JPG won't work for embroidery. Once you confirm, send the PO and deposit, and we'll start immediately.

rounds.ai_message: Got it, logo will be in AI format. I'll get back to you by tomorrow noon UK time. Thanks, Chen. Bye.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好,logo 用 AI 格式。明天中午英国时间回你。谢谢 Chen。再见。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 礼貌结束,确认收到,期待回复
rounds.common_mistakes: 结束不要太随便,可以加 'looking forward to working with you'。
rounds.tips_zh: 电话结束前再确认一次:什么时候收到回复,这就锁定了 follow-up 时点。
rounds.user_response_example: Thanks for the call, Sarah. I'll email the PI by tomorrow morning Beijing time. Looking forward to working with StyleHouse. Have a great evening.
